title: A little small but it'll do
text: A little small but it'll do. I purchased this as a replacement for a Soap/Sponge Caddy that we had for years, but sadly that style is no longer made. I thought this one resembled it close enough to give it a try but it's way too small. We're making it work so it's ok for the purpose it is meant for.

product_metadata.title: iDesign Rain Stainless Steel Drink Coasters with Holder for Home Counters, Kitchen, Dining Room, Living Room, Patio, Coffee Table, Set of 6, Clear
features: STYLISH COASTERS: Attractive and stylish round coasters for drinks, glasses, water, soda, cups, and mugs. Ideal for using in your living room, family room, dining room, kitchen counters, coffee tables, or patio
ATTRACTIVE: Simple, understated design that complements any décor
DURABLE: Durable clear plastic for long lasting protection
COMPACT: The included holder keeps the coasters in one convenient place
SET OF 6: Comes in a set of 6 coasters with one holder, perfect for entertaining
description: Save space and add style with the Rain Stainless Steel Coasters and Holder. Durable textured clear resipreme and brushed stainless steel accents allow these pieces to fit with any decor. A coaster is a necessity to keep coffee tables from looking like the lunar surface, this set of 6 will ensure you aren't dealing with unsightly condensation rings. The lipped edges on the coasters ensure that the drips stay on the coaster, not the table. The durable plastic coasters ensure long lasting protection for years of quality use. The attractive and functional Rain Stainless Steel Coasters with Holder are the perfect addition to your living space. With iDesign by InterDesign, you can #LiveSimply every day.
